includes: Showers and a buffet style lunch is provided.
Complimentary shuttle will be provided by the charter company to the main terminal of Harry Reid Airport or Excalibur and Treasure Island.
If you return to Page, transportation from the airport back to our fenced yard to your vehicle is provided by Wilderness River Adventures.
THE DAY THE TRIP TERMINATES AT DIAMOND CREEK Upon termination of your river trip at Diamond Creek, transportation to Page or Las Vegas is provided.
Transportation to Las Vegas, NV to Harry Reid International Airport is provided with an estimated arrival of 6:00pm.
